description: This Java source file defines the ContentBoxesController class, a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing content box entities within an admin panel, including listing, creating, viewing, and saving content boxes. It interacts with services like ContentService and LanguageService to perform CRUD operations and handles web requests relating to content box management.

classes.name: ContentBoxesController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller class for managing content box entities within an admin interface.

methods.name: boxPositions
methods.description: Provides a set of box position options ('LEFT', 'RIGHT') for views.

methods.name: listContentBoxes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list content boxes.

methods.name: createBox
methods.description: Handles GET requests to create a new content box, initializing the content object and positions.

methods.name: getContentDetails
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific content box by ID.

methods.name: saveContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a content box entity.
